name: Cole: A Mafia Story
source:
Mafia King Cole Mauricio isn't a man you walk away from. His presence commands a room, exuding danger and charisma. You're starting your life over again after a terrible event shook your whole world. When a chance encounter at your new apartment thrusts you and Cole together, will you be pulled into his dark web?

[From in-app]
translation:
黑手党之王科尔·毛里西奥，是个让人无法轻易抽身离开的男人。他一出现便掌控全场，浑身散发着危险与魅力。一场可怕的变故曾颠覆你的世界，如今，你正试着重新开始生活。在新公寓的一次偶遇，让你与科尔产生了交集。你会被卷入他编织的黑暗之网吗？

[译自应用内简介]
